title: HTML Foundations
description: Take your first step into web development. Learn how to structure web pages with HTML — the language every website on the internet is built with. No prior experience needed.

modules.title: First Steps
modules.description: Write your very first lines of HTML and understand the basic building blocks of every web page.

modules.title: Text & Structure
modules.description: Learn to organize content with headings, format text, and build lists — the core of every web page.

modules.title: Media & Links
modules.description: Connect your pages to the world with hyperlinks and bring them to life with images.

modules.title: Final Project
modules.description: Combine everything you've learned to build the HTML structure of a freelance copywriter's landing page — the same page you'll style in CSS Essentials.

learningOutcomes: Understand what HTML is and how browsers render it
Write well-structured HTML documents with proper document structure
Use headings, paragraphs, bold, and italic elements for text content
Add hyperlinks and control how they open
Insert images with proper alt text for accessibility
Build the complete HTML structure of a professional landing page from scratch
